verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a SQL warehouse, so its operations are inherently set-based. The remote MCP server's query_rw tool lets agents run INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and schema changes across whole tables. Flights run scheduled Python jobs for ingest and transformation, and the docs describe bulk-loading whole databases or tables from Postgres/MySQL. missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-driven bulk or batch semantics (limits, transactions, multi-object operations), independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk agent workflows.
